summary_1line: Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana leave Bharadwaja, build a raft, cross the Yamuna, pray to the river and a sacred tree, and continue toward Chitrakuta.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama and Lakshmana push a simple bamboo raft carrying Sita across the flowing Yamuna beneath a wide open sky.
In the middle of the river, Sita bows with folded hands toward the Yamuna, praying for Rama’s safe return to Ayodhya.
Sita reverently circumambulates a great dark-leaved fig tree on the riverbank while Rama and Lakshmana watch in the forest shade.
